content.prompt: Your task is to swap adjacent letters in a RandomAccessFile. Simply read two bytes, back up by two bytes, and write the values out. If the file has an odd number of bytes, don't swap the last one. Also, don't swap byte pairs that contain the newline or return characters ('\n' or '\r'). If either byte of a pair equals one of these characters, skip the pair and move on to the next pair.
